Edgerton.note: Wikipedia 2008 track side (Edgerton Depot, Edgerton, WI). Dark 'dull red vitrified brick' (NRHP), cast-stone trim, light grey asphalt roof, dark sash.

Stoughton.note: Wikipedia (CMStP&P Depot, Stoughton) and the Historical Society photo. Cream stucco, maroon-brown fascia and trim, brown brick piers with cream blocks.

Columbus.note: Tom's own photos (Research Library / RSW / Stations / Wisconsin / Columbus / Photos (private), IMG_2917-2941, sunny day). Warm gray-taupe rusticated concrete, smoother base course, white soffits, brackets and window frames, dark gray asphalt roof, red doors, brick inside the entrance arches.

Monroe.note: railpictures.net (Greg Mross) colour photo before the 1993 move. Pale yellow body, maroon-brown trim and wainscot, green shingles, red brick chimney (a later repaint - the standard was light gray with dark gray trim).

Corliss.note: railpictures.net (Greg Mross) colour photo at Sturtevant, Milwaukee Road era, evening light corrected using the cream door as white. Tan-brown siding, cream window and door trim, dark grey shingles. (Painted white later, mustard yellow at Caledonia since 2010.)
